```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
set.seed(501322)
library(ISLR2)
library(tidyverse)
library(tree)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
worldCupMatches <- read_csv("dataset/WorldCupMatches.csv")
worldCups <- read_csv("dataset/WorldCups.csv")
host_countries <- read_csv("dataset/host_countries.csv")
qualified_teams <- read_csv("dataset/qualified_teams.csv")
teams <- read_csv("dataset/teams.csv")
```

Figure out how to predict average goals per game based on total goals, world cups entered, and use that to make the bracket and predict the winner.

```{r}
qt_reduced_p <- qualified_teams %>% select(team_name, performance)
qt_gather <- gather(qt_reduced_p, key, performance, -team_name) %>%
  group_by(team_name, key, performance) %>%
  tally %>%
  spread(performance, n, fill = 0)
qt_gather_clean <- data.frame(team_name = as.factor(qt_gather$team_name), final = qt_gather$final + qt_gather$`final round`, thirdplace = qt_gather$`third-place match`, semi = qt_gather$`semi-finals`, quarter = qt_gather$`quarter-final` + qt_gather$`quarter-finals`, r16 = qt_gather$`round of 16`, groupstage = qt_gather$`group stage` + qt_gather$`second group stage`)
qt_gather_clean

qt_reduced_c <- qualified_teams %>% select(team_name, count_matches)
qt_match_c = qt_reduced_c %>% group_by(team_name) %>%
                   summarise(total_matches = sum(count_matches))
qt_match_c$team_name <- as.factor(qt_match_c$team_name)
qt_match_c
```

```{r}
wcm_reduced <- worldCupMatches %>% select(`Home Team Name`, `Home Team Goals`, `Away Team Name`, `Away Team Goals`, Attendance)

wcm_long <- bind_rows(
  wcm_reduced %>% select(team_name = `Home Team Name`, goals = `Home Team Goals`, Attendance),
  wcm_reduced %>% select(team_name = `Away Team Name`, goals = `Away Team Goals`, Attendance)
)

wcm_stats <- wcm_long %>%
  group_by(team_name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_goals = sum(goals, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_goals = mean(goals, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_attendance = sum(Attendance, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_attendance = mean(Attendance, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_games = n()
  )
wcm_stats$team_name <- as.factor(wcm_stats$team_name)

wcm_stats
```

```{r}
hc_sum <- table(host_countries$team_name)
hc_sum_df <- as.data.frame(hc_sum)
hc_sum_df <- hc_sum_df %>% rename(team_name = Var1, hostoccurances = Freq)
hc_sum_df
```

```{r}
teams_reduced <- teams %>% select(team_name, mens_team, womens_team, confederation_code)
teams_reduced$genderfactor <- as.factor(ifelse(teams_reduced$mens_team == 1, ifelse(teams_reduced$womens_team == 1, "MW", "M"), "W"))
teams_reduced$team_name <- as.factor(teams_reduced$team_name)
teams_reduced$confederation_code <- as.factor(teams_reduced$confederation_code)
teams_reduced
```

```{r}
df1 <- qt_match_c %>% rename(Country = team_name)
df2 <- qt_gather_clean %>% rename(Country = team_name)
df3 <- wcm_stats %>% rename(Country = team_name)
df4 <- hc_sum_df %>% rename(Country = team_name)
df5 <- teams_reduced %>% rename(Country = team_name)
all_dfs <- list(df1, df2, df3, df4, df5)

data <- Reduce(
  function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "Country", all = TRUE), 
  all_dfs
)

data_clean <- data %>%
  mutate(Country = case_when(
    Country %in% c("C�te d'Ivoire") ~ "Ivory Coast",
    Country %in% c("IR Iran") ~ "Iran",
    Country %in% c("Korea DPR") ~ "North Korea",
    Country %in% c("Korea Republic") ~ "South Korea",
    Country %in% c('rn">Bosnia and Herzegovina') ~ "Bosnia and Herzegovina",
    Country %in% c('rn">Republic of Ireland') ~ "Republic of Ireland",
    Country %in% c('rn">Serbia and Montenegro') ~ "Serbia and Montenegro",
    Country %in% c('rn">Trinidad and Tobago') ~ "Trinidad and Tobago",
    Country %in% c('rn">United Arab Emirates') ~ "United Arab Emirates",
    Country %in% c("USA") ~ "United States",
    Country %in% c("China PR") ~ "China",
    Country %in% c("German DR") ~ "East Germany",
    Country %in% c("Germany FR") ~ "West Germany",
    #Country %in% c("Czechoslovakia") ~ "Czech Republic",
    #Country %in% c("Soviet Union") ~ "Russia",
    #Country %in% c("Yugoslavia") ~ "Serbia",
    TRUE ~ Country
  )) %>%
  group_by(Country) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ {
    valid_values <- na.omit(.x)
    if (length(valid_values) > 0) valid_values[1] else NA
  }))

data_clean$hostoccurances <- ifelse(is.na(data_clean$hostoccurances), 0, data_clean$hostoccurances)
data_clean$total_goals <- ifelse(is.na(data_clean$total_goals), 0, data_clean$total_goals)
data_clean$Country <- as.factor(data_clean$Country)
data_clean <- subset(data_clean, select = -c(mens_team, womens_team))
data_clean <- data_clean[-nrow(data_clean),]
data_clean

write.csv(data_clean, "data_clean.csv")
```

```{r}
set.seed(501322)

data_nocountry <- subset(data_clean, select = -c(Country, total_goals))
data_noNA <- na.omit(data_nocountry)

train_index <- sample(82, size = 60, replace = FALSE)
train_main <- data_noNA[train_index,]
test_main <- data_noNA[-train_index,]

x_train <- subset(train_main, select = c(total_matches, final, thirdplace, semi, quarter, r16, groupstage, total_attendance, hostoccurances, confederation_code, genderfactor))
y_train <- subset(train_main, select = avg_goals)

x_test <- subset(test_main, select = c(total_matches, final, thirdplace, semi, quarter, r16, groupstage, total_attendance, hostoccurances, confederation_code, genderfactor))
y_test <- subset(test_main, select = avg_goals)

write.csv(x_train, "x_train.csv")
write.csv(x_test, "x_test.csv")
write.csv(y_train, "y_train.csv")
write.csv(y_test, "y_test.csv")
```
